Alice W: CI microbench alert on PR #21099, threshold diff +12% on sampler path. Link: <https://ci.redwood.local/job/21099>
Ben K: saw it, looks like sampler tap count increased, tail latency up
Carla M: relevant diff landed in 21099: changed kernel-autoselect heuristics -> added prefetch window
Dmitri L: @Carla can you paste the commit? suspecting prefetch triggers batch widening
Carla M: `commit 3f4a2b: kernel: sampler: prefer-wide-batches when seq_len>512`
Ben K: repro locally with `ci microbench --profile sampler --runs 10` -> heatmap shows extra kernel switch at step 4
Alice W: flamegraph (snippet):
```
kernel_selector
  kernel_autoselect
    kv_cache_miss
      batch_coalesce
```
Dmitri L: kv hitrate dropped from 92% -> 74% in the perf run :thinking_face:
Carla M: hmm, we changed kv prefetch window from 2->4 in that commit
Ben K: quick experiment: revert the window change in tree and run shadow bench
deploy-bot: Deploy status: shadow benches queued (id=shdw-8132)
Ben K: shadow result: sampler throughput -9%, kv_hitrate -18%, tail latency +25%
Alice W: marking PR as rollout-blocker, need bisect plan
Dmitri L: bisect suspects: kernel-autoselect heuristics vs prefetch change. I'll bisect commits between 3f4a2b..HEAD
Carla M: ack. I'll prepare a quick revert PR for the prefetch window change
Ben K: also adding temporary autotune:cap to avoid widening until we have safe KV metrics
Alice W: thanks. Next update in this thread, ping @eng-runtime on revert merged
Carla M: revert PR opened: #21104
deploy-bot: CI for #21104 passed, shadow benches queued (id=shdw-8133)
Ben K: shadow #8133 shows perf back to baseline, merging revert
deploy-bot: Merge complete: #21104 merged by Carla M
Alice W: rolling out revert to canary, keeping the original PR blocked
Dmitri L: follow-up: we should adjust sampler unit test to include kv_hitrate assertion
Carla M: adding test now
Alice W: :thumbsup:
